note: 季節：冬。最初と最後が同じ絵（雪から顔だけ出たピコ）で、結果→「30分前」→また結果、とループする。

cuts.desc: 崩れた雪の山から顔だけ出したピコ（無表情）。上でゴンタがすやすや寝ている
cuts.action: A big messy pile of collapsed snow where a snow hut used to be. Only Piko's small white head sticks out of the snow with a blank deadpan stare, snowflakes on his head. Gonta sleeps happily belly-up on top of the snow pile

cuts.desc: ピコが小さなスコップで、せっせとかまくらを作る
cuts.action: Piko works very hard building a dome-shaped Japanese snow hut (kamakura), quickly piling and patting snow with a tiny shovel, running around it, wiping sweat from his forehead. Snowy clearing in a mountain forest, sunny winter day. Static camera, medium wide shot.

cuts.desc: ピカピカのかまくらの前で、腰に手を当ててドヤ顔のピコ
cuts.action: Piko stands proudly with hands on hips and a huge smug grin in front of a perfect, smooth, beautifully rounded snow dome hut (kamakura) with a neat arched entrance, sparkling in the sunshine

cuts.desc: ゴンタがのそのそ歩いてきて、かまくらの壁を「いい枕」みたいに見つめる
cuts.action: Gonta trudges slowly through deep snow toward the snow hut, yawning, his sleepy eyes fixed on the hut's smooth round wall as if it were a comfy pillow; Piko's small head peeks happily out of the hut's entrance

cuts.desc: かまくらの中でお茶を飲んでうっとりのピコ。入口の外にゴンタの大きな背中
cuts.action: Inside the cozy snow hut: Piko sits on a tiny cushion sipping hot tea from a small cup with blissful closed eyes, warm glow. Through the arched entrance, Gonta's big black furry back and red scarf can be seen leaning against the outside of the hut

cuts.desc: ゴンタが寄りかかって、かまくらが全壊。そのまま上で寝る
cuts.action: Gonta leans his whole heavy back against the snow hut to take a nap, the hut cracks and completely collapses under his weight in a big burst of powder snow, Gonta flops onto the snow pile and immediately falls asleep. Static camera, medium wide shot.

cuts.desc: 1カット目と同じ絵。顔だけ出たピコ、無言（ループ）
